fd.title: The Saigon Fashion Directory
fd.lede: Every house worth knowing in the city's fashion landscape — verified boutiques, ateliers, designer labels and markets — curated for clients of Seraphic Styler. Filter by what you're looking for, where you'll be, and how it's priced.
fd.browse.title: Browse by wardrobe
fd.browse.sub: Tap a category to jump straight to those houses — or open the full directory below and filter as finely as you like.
fd.mapsub: Saigon's fashion concentrates in a handful of districts — and often single streets. Tap an area to filter the directory to it.
fd.searchtip: Tip: clear the search to see every house again.
fd.conf.okl: Verified — address confirmed against the brand's own channels
fd.conf.warnl: Confirm first — message the shop before you go (single-source, pop-up or in flux)
fd.conf.stalel: May be outdated — kept for reference until re-verified
fd.legendmeta: Addresses are current to July 2026 from brands' own channels and 2025–26 press, each carried at the confidence noted above. Saigon boutiques relocate often — message a shop the day before you visit. Ward names changed mid-2025; Grab & Google Maps still resolve the older district labels. Hearts save to this browser only — no account, nothing leaves your device.
fd.transnote: The interface is available in the languages listed in the menu above. House notes, addresses, brand names and district names stay in their original language — those are the words you show a driver or a shop assistant.
fd.contactp: Personal styling & Vietnamese-fashion sourcing, shipping worldwide. We shop these houses so you don't have to.
fd.dyn.banner: Planning a trip around these houses? Read the field guide — getting around, dressing for the heat, and 1-to-30-day shopping itineraries.
fd.dyn.streetsSub: Saigon's fashion isn't spread evenly — these streets and buildings each hold several boutiques, the highest-value stops on any styling route.
fd.dyn.emptyP: Nothing in the directory fits that combination — Saigon's scene moves fast, but not that fast.
fd.dyn.shortlist: Your shortlist — saved to this browser only
fd.dyn.savedTip: Saved to this browser — no account needed.
fd.dyn.mapNote: Symbol area is proportional to house count (r = k·√n). The nine districts hold {d} walk-able houses; the chip above adds the {o} online & multi-brand names — together the {s} in Saigon.
fd.grp.women.d: Local design houses and boutiques — the heart of the Saigon scene, plus a few chains and Hanoi names.
fd.grp.men.d: Local menswear labels, streetwear flagships (most unisex-leaning) and made-to-measure suiting.
fd.grp.luxury.d: Designer labels and made-to-order houses. Most work by appointment; several show internationally.
fd.grp.tailor.d: Bespoke áo dài, made-to-measure ateliers, embroidery and upcycling — what's distinctive to Vietnam.
fd.grp.active.d: Studio-to-street activewear and functional sun-wear. No official Lululemon or Alo store exists in Vietnam yet.
fd.grp.access.d: Vietnamese accessory labels with real HCMC stores.
fd.grp.sleep.d: Cotton, linen and silk nightwear built for tropical nights — the natural-fibre houses, not the polyester-satin mass market.
fd.grp.market.d: Where many brands gather at once — highest value per trip. Dates roam; check socials first.
